source.title: Forebears Liberia forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Localized name pool refreshed against public frequency tables. Gender buckets remain sample-level because they are not sourced from an official civil registry.

source.title: ITU Liberia national numbering plan communication of 31.V.2024

phones.notes: ITU/LTA confirms Liberia country code +231, a closed numbering scheme, nine-digit mobile national significant numbers, and the listed NDCs. Generated values are synthetic and are not checked for live assignment or portability.

locations.notes: UPU confirms Liberia uses four-digit postcodes to the left of the locality and gives Monrovia 1000 as an example. City/street pairings remain synthetic review samples and are not delivery validated.

national_identification_number.label: National Identification Number

source.title: Liberia National Identification Registry e-Verification platform

national_identification_number.notes: Official NIR source confirms NIN verification and use as Liberia's identity source, but no public number grammar, checksum or allocation rule was found. The ten-digit template is a synthetic placeholder only.

passport.label: Passport
passport.notes: PRADO confirms Liberia ordinary passport document family, but the public entry reviewed does not confirm the visible passport number grammar. The template remains a synthetic placeholder.
